alt_text: Cover: Photosynthesis, P6 PSLE Science study notes.
What you need to know: topic map, skills checklist, and what is not in the P6 syllabus.
A leaf drawing: light energy, carbon dioxide and water go in; sugar and oxygen come out. Plus the definition to use in answers.
The bubble experiment: a lamp shining on a water plant under a funnel, with gas collecting in a test tube. More light gives more bubbles. How to make it a fair test.
Energy from the Sun to food to animals, respiration releases energy from food, and how plants and animals differ in getting energy.
Photosynthesis vs respiration comparison table, one plant in bright light vs dark, and two real-life examples.
Common mistakes with fixes, exam tips, and a model answer.
Answers to the eight questions, each with the reason.
